name: v1.0.28
body:
## Highlights

- Add Oh my Pi support to `mmx agent setup` (`--agent oh-my-pi`, alias `omp`), including interactive installation and native YAML configuration with profile support.
- Default `mmx text chat`, `mmx text repl`, and SDK text requests to `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview`. Explicit model selections and the CLI's saved `default-text-model` still take precedence.
- Agent setup defaults to M3.1 Flash Preview for subscription keys and MiniMax-M3 for pay-as-you-go keys.

**Model availability:** M3.1 Flash Preview currently requires M Plan or MiniMax Code. For pay-as-you-go text requests, explicitly select `MiniMax-M3`.

## What's Changed

* feat: add Oh my Pi setup and default text to M3.1 Flash Preview by @jellyjelly814 in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/282

## New Contributors

* @jellyjelly814 made their first contribution in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/282

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/compare/v1.0.27...v1.0.28
